name: Orthogonal_Projection_Entanglement
description: The 3-dimensional matching constraint is obfuscated by projecting the 3D choices onto two orthogonal 2D planes (XY and YZ) and requiring the resulting binary matrices to be permutation matrices. To achieve efficiency, the model must mathematically deduce that this implies all three coordinates are distinct, enabling dimension-grouped backtracking. Models that blindly translate the text will write a naive subset search and TLE.
